tools.name: thoughtindustries_ping
tools.description: Verify the API key and academy subdomain. Returns { valid: true } when the key works. REST: GET /ping.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_get_job
tools.description: Poll an asynchronous job (for example a bulk user import or course creation). Status is pending, processing, complete, or failed. REST: GET /jobs/{id}.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_list_users
tools.description: List users of one role (learners by default), cursor-paginated. There is no email or client filter on this list: use thoughtindustries_get_user for one user. REST: GET /users.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_get_user
tools.description: Get one user's full profile and enrollment details. The id can be the user UUID, email address, or externalCustomerId. REST: GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_list_content
tools.description: Browse or search published content. Without types, only courses and learning paths are returned. To find content by SKU, pass query as sku:"<sku>". REST: GET /content.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_list_course_groups
tools.description: List course groups, the catalog containers that hold courses and sessions. Returns id, title, sku, kind, and status. REST: GET /courseGroups.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_get_course_group
tools.description: Get one course group by UUID, with its courses and sessions. REST: GET /courseGroups/{id}.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_list_course_group_courses
tools.description: List the courses and sessions that belong to one course group. REST: GET /courseGroups/{id}/courses.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_get_course_structure
tools.description: Get the full outline of one course: sections, lessons, and topics. REST: GET /courses/{courseId}/structure.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_list_meetings
tools.description: List scheduled meetings, such as webinar and in-person event sessions. REST: GET /meetings.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_list_course_actions
tools.description: List course events: enrollments, status changes (starts and completions), certificate grants, and access revocations. This is the main feed for activity over time. REST: GET /events/courseAction.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_list_assessment_attempts
tools.description: List quiz and assessment attempts, with scores. Filter by user, course, or date range. REST: GET /assessmentAttempts.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_list_assignment_submissions
tools.description: List learner assignment submissions. Optional search query in the Thought Industries query language. REST: GET /assignmentSubmissions.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_list_clients
tools.description: List client organizations (Panorama accounts), with status and seat counts. REST: GET /clients.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_get_client
tools.description: Get one client organization by UUID. REST: GET /clients/{id}.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_list_client_licenses
tools.description: List the licenses assigned to one client organization. REST: GET /clients/{id}/licenses.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_list_non_recurring_purchases
tools.description: List one-time (non-subscription) purchases made on the academy. REST: GET /ecommerce/nonRecurringPurchases.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_list_coupons
tools.description: List the coupons defined on the academy. REST: GET /coupons.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_list_redemption_codes
tools.description: List redemption code groups, which grant content access. REST: GET /redemptionCodes.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_create_user
tools.description: Create a user account. Email must be unique on the academy. This tool does not set a role; use the academy to change roles. REST: POST /users.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_update_user
tools.description: Change profile fields of one user. Pass only the fields to change. REST: PUT /users/{id}.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_update_user_status
tools.description: Enable or disable a user account. A disabled user cannot sign in. Setting the same status again changes nothing. REST: PUT /users/{id}/updateStatus.

tools.name: thoughtindustries_bulk_assign_content
tools.description: Enroll many users in one course or learning path in one request. Enrollment can notify learners and start access. REST: POST /users/bulkContentAssignment.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: thoughtindustries_list_users, thoughtindustries_get_user, thoughtindustries_list_course_actions · Private data: thoughtindustries_ping · Public sink: thoughtindustries_list_users, thoughtindustries_get_user, thoughtindustries_create_user, thoughtindustries_bulk_assign_content.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: thoughtindustries_list_users, thoughtindustries_get_user, thoughtindustries_list_course_actions · Private data: thoughtindustries_ping · Public sink: thoughtindustries_list_users, thoughtindustries_get_user, thoughtindustries_create_user, thoughtindustries_bulk_assign_content

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
